purpose: Provided ray-mesh building model LOS diagnostics, mixed LOD1/2; model uncertainty retained
source: Official PLATEAU CityGML API mesh inventory; source details in coverageMeshes and each building
sourceSha256Definition: SHA256 of sorted unique source GML hashes joined by newline; this is aggregate, not a source GML hash

skytree.evidence: Named 東京スカイツリー; target coordinate in raw roof-edge/ground polygon, upper solid635.141m; contact diagnosis only, not blanket exclusion

targetSurfaceWhitelistEvidence.definition: Source-bound target upper tower faces: all vertices within50m model axis and whole face minZ above160.392m (maximum Z of source compound faces wholly beyond50m axis), union prior17 upper shaft/cap faces; not entire target compound.
targetSurfaceWhitelistEvidence.thresholdSource: Maximum Z over391 compound faces whose entire projected face is at least50m from model axis

limits: LOD1 is a usable coarse model with height/shape uncertainty, not absent data or a true upper envelope.
Mesh file provision records available model inventory; not perfect real-world building/tree completeness.
Target association source hash is per-building source, not aggregate index hash; consumer must verify against building.sourceSha256/sourceSha256s.
Target compound geometry retained; contact classification is separate, not visibility clear.
No guaranteed field visibility or standing-surface certification.

vertexEncoding.quantization: Existing source index precision 1e-8 degree and1mm only; no additional rounding/simplification.

arrayLayout.vertexCoordinates: XYZ triplets; unique within each building, global vertex ordinal
arrayLayout.ringVertexIndices: Global vertex ordinals, closing vertices preserved
arrayLayout.faceRingOffsets: Face f rings at [faceRingOffsets[f],faceRingOffsets[f+1]); first exterior, remaining holes
arrayLayout.sourcePolygonIndex: For face f in building b, f-b.firstFace equals unchanged original building.polygons ordinal; re-extract original sourceSha256 with extract-mixed-index.py to resolve raw source polygon.
arrayLayout.targetPolygonIds: Only target-associated buildings retain original polygon IDs, arrays aligned with sourcePolygonIndex.

geometrySelection.kind: Current dynamic observer to target convex envelope+200m union explicit full source meshes
geometrySelection.method: Convex hull offset halfplanes, capped by original hull bbox+200m; conservative miter buffer. Building bbox transformed at four corners with extra1m safety padding.
geometrySelection.outsideSelectedEnvelope: Not included, unknown model coverage; celestial rays outside selection require separate coverage handling.

targetRayRetentionProof.scope: Current600 observer→Skytree target636 horizontal geodesic paths and finite model-height ECEF target rays only. Not arbitrary celestial rays outside selected domain.
targetRayRetentionProof.interveningChordContainment: Convex envelope contains endpoint vertices and therefore every chord of the frontend 100m polyline.
targetRayRetentionProof.ecefAssumption: Same uncorrected orthometric-as-ellipsoidal model assumption as frontend; this is inclusion proof, not field-accuracy proof.
targetRayRetentionProof.geodesicVertexConvention: WGS84 Geod.forward at0,100,200,...m and explicit target endpoint; frontend Vincenty convention
targetRayRetentionProof.observerGroundAssumption: GSI native5→10 terrain pixel +1.5m eye. Model only; bridge/elevated surfaces remain separate eligibility.

providedMeshLineProof.scope: Official model file availability along these current600 lines; not real-world completeness/visibility guarantee.
